title: Team
subtitle: Account members, their roles, and pending invitations.

access.explainCheckbox: Check the companies, locations, or groups this member has access to. A node that appears checked and disabled is included through a grant made higher up the tree (labeled "via").
access.explainVisibility: This access controls what the member can see and open from the dashboard — it does not prevent a direct connection to a machine whose password they already know from another source.
